h:
使用 ControlNet-LLLite 的 Anima 简单工作流程。

v3.0

ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite已更新并且节点 ID 冲突已得到解决（提交 1127343).

如果您想要使用“Apply Anima ControlNet LLLite”节点的 kohya-ss 版本（现已命名为“Apply Anima ControlNet-LLLite (sd-scripts)”），则应使用 v3 工作流程。

v2 工作流程仍然可以与官方“Apply Anima LLLite [BETA]”节点结合使用。

v1 工作流程已被弃用，因为它不再与最新版本兼容ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite.

v2.0

如果您使用 ComfyUI 0.29.0 或更高版本，则应使用 v2 工作流程。

如果您使用的是 0.29.0 以下版本的 ComfyUI 以及来自以下版本的自定义节点，则可以使用 v1 工作流程https://github.com/kohya-ss/ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite.

进一步阅读

根本原因是新引入的本机节点“Apply Anima LLLite [BETA]”与之前可用的自定义节点“Apply Anima ControlNet-LLLite”之间的节点名称冲突。两个节点使用相同的内部名称“AnimaLLLiteApply”。

Anima Beta Controlnet 崩溃 · 问题 #14123 · Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend · GitHub

[ComfyUI] 修复 Anima-LLLite 更新后停止工作的问题｜つみき

o.en:
A simple workflow for Anima using ControlNet-LLLite.

v3.0

ComfyUI-Anima-LLLitehas been updated and the node ID conflict has been addressed (Commit 1127343).

You should use the v3 workflow if you want to use the kohya-ss version of the "Apply Anima ControlNet LLLite" node, which is now named "Apply Anima ControlNet-LLLite (sd-scripts)".

The v2 workflow is still available in combination with the official "Apply Anima LLLite [BETA]" node.

The v1 workflow is deprecated since it is no longer compatible with the latest version ofComfyUI-Anima-LLLite.

v2.0

You should use the v2 workflow if you are using ComfyUI 0.29.0 or higher.

You can use the v1 workflow if you are using ComfyUI of the version below 0.29.0 and the custom node fromhttps://github.com/kohya-ss/ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite.

Further reading

The root cause is a node name conflict between the newly introduced native node "Apply Anima LLLite [BETA]" and the previously available custom node "Apply Anima ControlNet-LLLite". Both nodes use the same internal name, "AnimaLLLiteApply".
